programme.desc: All over the world men and women fight for the protection of nature reserves and endangered species. This is their story, a story of bravery and stamina. We visit scientists in Central Europe who monitor the offspring of the rare lynx nearly 200 years after these elusive cats were extinct in the wild. We follow the work of the moose detective in Sweden on the island of Oland who tries to solve the riddle of increasing numbers of dead moose calves. In the heart of Africa one woman and her guards try to protect rare lowland gorillas and forest elephants but the increasing bush meat trade and the ongoing ivory smuggling makes their work extremely dangerous. Last but not least we meet US...

programme.title: mareTV: La Palma: The Greenest of the Canaries
programme.desc: Thundering waterfalls, ancient forests and an impressive volcanic landscape with black beaches: La Palma is a dream island for nature lovers. It is by far the island of the Canary Islands with the most green, almost half of it is covered with forest. But once a year the green island is dominated by the color white. On Rosenmontag (Rose Monday), the inhabitants have for decades been targeting those ancestors who returned from abroad wealthy and ostentatiously demonstrated their wealth with powdered faces. The carnivalistic approach culminates every year in a white chaos, with tons of talcum, flour or paint trickling down the uniformly white dressed islanders. On the Roque de los Muchachos,...

programme.title: The Canary Islands - In the Shadows of the Volcanoes
programme.desc: The Canary Islands were born in the depths of the ocean. Forged by fire and sculpted by winds and waves, this volcanic land offers landscapes of colossal force and almost unreal beauty.

programme.title: mareTV: Santorini - The Beauty on the Powder Keg
programme.desc: The Santorini archipelago is a gem, but is located on a veritable powder keg. It is only a matter of time before the volcano, the crater rim of which gave us this island world, erupts again. Since January 2011, threatening rumblings have been perceived beneath the archipelago. On Santorini, it's a case of getting nowhere fast without a mule. Whether the restaurant terraces above the abyss of Oia, the hotels on the breath-taking cliffs of Imerovigli or Firostefani, it was only with the help of the stubborn climbing artists, that these daring constructions were made possible. Antonis Vlachos has ten strong mules that work for him. He transports almost everything with them: stones, food or...

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Secrets of the Mediterranean, Ep.1
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Secrets of the Mediterranean, Ep. 2
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. The continents are moving towards one another. Animals, that have to survive under such extreme conditions, must find a way to escape the dangers. Between deserts and volcanoes, the challenges for the animals are enormous.

programme.title: mareTV: Hong Kong - Metropolis in the sea
programme.desc: Hong Kong translated means "fragrant harbour". The days of the spicy smoking ceremonies have passed, but MareTV has discovered many delightful contrasts between the metropolis and Mother Nature. In for-mer times, the rare eagle wood tree grew here. Its wood put the spice into the Taoist smoking ceremonies. The fragrant harbour: what sounds so charming is today a huge metropolis in the sea. No other tiny piece of land is more densely populated. Star Ferries have been commuting between the Kowloon Peninsula and central Hong Kong for the past 125 years. The British colonial masters are long gone, but on the ancient ferries, virtually nothing has changed. Most of the ships are still clad in...

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Bernina Express, Suisse
programme.desc: Over 196 bridges and through 55 tunnels, the Bernina Express fights its way from Switzerland to Italy. Powerful forces of nature make the railyway line a dangerous route over the Grisons Alps to this day. The film accompanies the Bernina Express in winter over the highest rail route across the Alps.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway (Tazara) is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects. It connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and meant independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa. The film accompanies the Tazara on its 52-hour journey through Tanzania and Zambia and uses spectacular aerial shots to show not only the architectural monuments but also the unknown sides of the previously hidden landscapes of Tanzania and Zambia.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The Pamban Railway, India
programme.desc: The Pamban Railway crosses the tropical landscape of Tamil Nadu, the former Madras, for around 600 kilometers. Heavy storms and rain showers make the route a challenge for Indian Railways to this day. The film accompanies the "Rameswaram Express" over the notorious Pamban Bridge, the first bridge across the Indian Ocean.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Ferrocarril del Sur, one of the highest train routes on earth, runs right through the mountains of Peru. To this day, it is considered a miracle in the world of railways. The rails not only lead to the famous ruined city of Machu Picchu but connect the ancient Inca capital of Cusco with Puno on the shores of Lake Titicaca and the gleaming white city of Arequipa. A train journey with the Andes Explorer through a grandiose landscape and an undeveloped and inaccessible area.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The Train to the Clouds, Argentina
programme.desc: In northern Argentina, the world-famous Tren a las Nubes - the cloud train - crosses dizzying viaducts and deep valleys. At an altitude of over 4000 meters, what was once the highest railway runs past cactus forests and into the driest desert in the world. A technical feat in the Andes and a breathtaking ride through spectacular scenery.In northern Argentina, the world-famous Tren a las Nubes - the cloud train - crosses dizzying viaducts and deep valleys. At an altitude of over 4000 meters, what was once the highest railway runs past cactus forests and into the driest desert in the world. A technical feat in the Andes and a breathtaking ride through spectacular scenery.

programme.title: mareTV: The Blue and White Island World of Greece: Mykonos, Naxos and Tinos
programme.desc: Around the once sacred Isle of Delos, some 200 islands, including 20 larger ones, are arranged almost in a circle. This is where the name of the Greek island paradise comes from: Cyclades, a derivation of the Greek word kýklos, circle. Each cyclade has a unique character. The pelican Petros, about 20 years old, is the mascot of Mykonos. He moves from taverna to taverna all day long, scrounging fish. This works out sometimes well and sometimes not so well. Petros does have a few human friends who regularly slip him something, but all too often visitors eager to take pictures block his path. Then he has to "wiggle" his way through the crowd. Jackie Onassis is said to have once brought...

programme.title: The Provence coast - Marseille and the Côte Bleue
programme.desc: The Provence is famed for its endless fields of laven-der, but this lush landscape also has a beautifully mari-time touch: The Côte Bleue! Small, hidden beaches, charming harbour towns, imposing, craggy bays and a uniquely clear light that has attracted painters includ-ing Cézanne and Braque. The coast derives its name from the deep blue water and extends from Marseille to Martigues. This small town is also known as "The Ven-ice of the North", as it is shaped entirely by water: an inland lake, the sea itself, as well as a connecting canal. In the bays of the Calanques, the steeply-walled coastal inlets in the Mediterranean limestone, Lionel Franc is a cliff diver. His personal record is a...

programme.title: Wild & Wide Awake - From the Mediterranean to the Alps
programme.desc: The first part of the spring journey takes us from the Spanish inland to the rugged Atlantic and to the Mediterranean, through the French Provence, and finally into the Alps. Along the way, flamingos perform their bizarre dancing rituals, wild horses storm through the wetland… While the North is still covered by snow and ice, the South will soon turn into a blooming garden and every creature is enjoying the first signs of the awakening.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share...

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Magic Lakes
programme.desc: At 117 square kilometres, the Müritz is the largest lake on German territory, but it’s far from the only one in the north east of the country. Even the Mecklenburg Lake District, between Waren and Feldberg, contains around 2 lakes alone. Thanks to the Müritz National Park the species diversity is particularly high in the region: half of the German crane population breeds in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the osprey is typical of the Müritz area; the lively Eurasian otter hunts here; and the endangered red milan circles the skies above. Fred Bollmann knows the national park like hardly any other. The former ranger and voluntary nature conservationist is actively involved in the preservation of...

programme.title: The Seychelles - Africa with South Seas ambience
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars,...

programme.title: Germany's Wild Reservoirs
programme.desc: One of the smallest dams in the Bergisches Land is the Panzertalsperre, with an area of just four-and-a-half football pitches. On the other hand, the Dhünntalsperre is the largest with the area of 660 football pitches. They all transform a stretch of flowing water into still and stagnant water. As a result, completely diverse ecosystems have developed there: where the dipper once dived for insect larvae, cormorants and gray herons now fish and swans and coots cavort. In recent summers, even greater challenges have emerged: the effects of climate change - from extreme drought to destructive floods. On a smaller scale, a rather industrious dam master is operating flood protection: The...

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field...

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola....

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is...

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard...

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Breath of the Arctic - Wilderness North
programme.desc: This foray through northern realms of our planet above the polar circle takes us to a part of our world especially affected by climate change. The often-cited adaptability of animals could also enable them to survive under new conditions. The camera team made this foray through the polar region, from Canada to Norway, to document that, which in the opinion of many nature researchers, will no longer be visible in 30 to 50 years' time. Following the observation of ice bear mother with her young in Canada's Wapusk National Park at Hudson Bay, is a herd of harp seals on the ice during the breeding season. The Arctic Ocean ringed seals in Hudson Bay, on the other hand, prefer solitude. Should...

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Hunters of the Skies
programme.desc: Birds of prey are symbols of power, speed and splendour. In fact, there are very few species in the animal kingdom that can be described in as many superlatives. Their amazing use of different senses, their incredible feats of flight as well as their multitude of different hunting strategies are simply astounding. Hawks, buzzards and eagles have conquered every habitat on earth - from the dry arid south, to the cool and moist river valleys, to the coasts of Norway, all the way up to the sparse high mountains. Some of them, like the incredibly versatile hawk, can even hunt in the forest. Their literal eagle eye vision is unrivaled in the animal kingdom. All birds of prey sustain themselves...

programme.title: Hoanib - The Secret of the Desert Elephants
programme.desc: The Namib, one of the most hostile deserts on Earth. Without a firm survival strategy, no living soul will make it here. Yet, surprisingly, some species have adapted their lifestyles to these extreme conditions: chameleons, beetles, snakes and mammals are all at home here. The film follows a family of desert elephants that has also adapted to this habitat.

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple...

programme.title: The Turkish Riviera - The flair of antiquity and a turquoise sea
programme.desc: With a coastline boasting miles of bathing beaches, turquoise waters, breath-taking cliffs whilst being steeped in history, the Turkish riviera was even a fa-vourite of the Ancient Greeks, Romans and Ottomans, who all loved the mild climate and the lush landscape. Near the ruins of the ancient city of Side, Menderes Akdemir works on the latest attraction aimed at Riviera holidaymakers: his spooky pirate ship "Big Kral" is due to leave dry dock and head for the sea. Mehmet Özata came up with a very clever idea: to be able to cope with the basically ruinous puffer fish plague along the coastline, he produces a selection of leather utensils made of their skin. The islands that surround the...

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Across Alaska in a Cessna
programme.desc: Alaska - the largest and at the same time most sparsely populated state in the USA. Only about 740,000 people live here. Often far away in small villages. Almost every village has its own airstrip. Aircrafts are one of the main means of transport in Alaska. Jamie Klaes is one of the many female pilots in the country.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Aerobatics is the supreme discipline in air sports. Only a few pilots dare to navigate a machine during loops, drops and steep flights because nausea and blackouts due to the strong G-forces can be life-threatening. But flight instructor Jenny Holmenes is not deterred - she wants to prove her skills. Although she is still a beginner, she competes in the "Sportsman" class at the Norwegian Aerobatic Championships.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Bush Pilots in the Australian Outback
programme.desc: Living conditions are harsh in the Australian outback, especially in William Creek. Only 17 people live here, and in summer even less - only two. There is a motel, a campsite, a pub and the only petrol station in a radius of hundreds of miles. The young bush pilot Hannah Jane Cash lives and works here.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 In an Airbus over Jordan
programme.desc: Alia Twal is an enthusiastic pilot, globetrotter and adventurer. She is a first officer with the Jordanian airline Royal Jordanian and flies large passenger planes. She climbs the highest mountains in the world, dives with sharks or goes skydiving. Alia particularly enjoys travelling in her Jordanian homeland.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 A Helicopter Heroine in the Himalayas
programme.desc: Nepal is one of the poorest countries in the world. Young women are often disadvantaged here and quite a few are married off before the age of 18. Helicopter pilot Priya Adhikari lives and works here. The 38-year-old is an exception and the only woman in Nepal who ventures into the extremely dangerous heights of the Himalayas in her helicopter.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Wild Moments: Four Seasons - Spring & Summer
programme.desc: In accordance with the seasons and with deep respect of nature, people all over the world celebrate their long-standing traditions. In Japan the first picnics at the cherry blossom festival kick off the long-awaited outdoor season, while the Scots perform their Highland Games. In the summer the Latvians celebrate the biggest party of the year: midsummer night. The vast wildflower meadows provide them with wreathes of flowers which have magical healing powers; animals are provided with an abundance of insects. This enables the rare hoopoe to breed in Latvia. In the Spree forest region, an enchanting river landscape south-east of Berlin, farmers still harvest the famous Spreeforest...

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Wild Moments: 4 Seasons - Autumn & Winter
programme.desc: In accordance with the seasons and with deep respect of nature, people all over the world celebrate their long-standing traditions. Near the outermost border of Europe, in Bashkiria, generations of bee keepers have collected honey from rare wild bees, the Burzyan bees. In Japan the last of the Usho catch fish with "living fishing rods": trained cormorants. Traditionally, they provided the Emperor's family with fresh fish. In Poland carp are fished from the ponds to provide everybody with carp for Christmas dinner - this is an old Polish tradition. In Frisia winter is driven out by fires at what is known as "Biikebrennen", and in Hungary the "Busho" - frightening characters wearing wooden...

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Antarctica - Tales from the End of the World
programme.desc: The Antarctic region is undoubtedly one of the most remote and inhospitable, yet one of the most beautiful landscapes of the world. This documentary takes us on a journey to the stormy isolated islands of the Southern Ocean. Seals, penguins, seabirds and numerous other animals live and breed in this hostile environment and harsh climate. Only by an icebreaker can we reach the remote coasts of the Antarctic continent where Emperor Penguins defy the life-threatening environment of the vast ice desert at the end of the world.

programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns...

programme.title: Menorca - Majorca's beautiful sister
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones...

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza - Island of Light
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But...

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river’s delta in the Netherlands, flows...

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds....

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Children of the Sun - Butterflies
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is a road of mountain passes and India’s access to the roof of the world – the Himalayas. This 475-kilometre long route at the northernmost tip of the Indian subcontinent connects the cities of Manali and Leh at the heart of the Ladakh region. The term “highway” applies quite literally, since the route traverses five of the highest drivable mountain passes in the world – among these the Lohtang La at 3,978 metres above sea level, the Lachulung La at 5,059 metres and the Tanglang La at 5,325 metres. Crossing these passes is a challenge for both vehicle and man. The mountain peaks, still snow-capped even in the depths of summer, wide variety of vegetation and the fantastic and craggy...

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Nawabpur Road in Dhaka

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Part 1: Rise of Civilization
programme.desc: In the region that includes the Mediterranean, the Aegean, Mesopotamia and Egypt, the Bronze Age arrived about 3000 BC and lasted nearly 2000 years. What singled out this period and the new societies and cities that emerged? The development of formal writing is one among several important factors.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Part 2: Masters Of Trade
programme.desc: Trade, and in particular trade in luxury goods, drove the commerce economies of the Bronze Age. This is the time when the first super powers in history, Egypt and Mesopotamia, emerge and dominate the "world" stage of the Mediterranean and Aegean seas and surrounding areas.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Part 3: Conquest And Collapse
programme.desc: The Bronze Age had the first large urban centers, powerful kingdoms and armies, writing, and trade routes across vast areas. What led to the collapse of the city-state entities and the end of the Bronze Age? Possibly a perfect storm of uncontrollable factors that are still being researched.

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Episode 1: The Rise Of Civilization
programme.desc: About 8,000 BC, in a few select places some people begin to experiment with a new way of harvesting energy. They’re growing their own crops.

programme.title: Voice from the stone
programme.desc: 1950-luvun Toscanaan sijoittuva Voice from the Stone on kummitteleva ja jännittävä tarina Verenasta, vakavasta sairaanhoitajasta, joka kutsutaan auttamaan pientä poikaa, joka on vaiennut äitinsä äkillisen poismenon jälkeen.

programme.title: Before Dawn
programme.desc: Nuori mies jättää perheensä lammastilan taakseen Australian takamailla ja liittyy maanmiestensä joukkoon länsirintamalle ensimmäiseen maailmansotaan. Heidän tavoitteenaan on nopeuttaa verisen konfliktin päättymistä. Mutta sodan raivotessa miehen täytyy selvitä juoksuhautojen ankarassa todellisuudessa ja taistelun välittömässä vaarassa pysyäkseen hengissä – ja jättämättä ketään taakseen.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Vice - vallan oikeat kasvot
programme.desc: VICE – VALLAN OIKEAT KASVOT pureutuu eeppiseen tarinaan byrokraattisen Washingtonin sisäpiiriläisestä, Richard Bruce (Dick) Cheneystä, joka nousi vaivihkaa George W. Bushin varapresidentiksi, maailman vaikutusvaltaisimmaksi mieheksi, mullistaen amerikkalaista poliittista kulttuuria niin, että sen kaikuja kuullaan vielä tänäkin päivänä.

programme.title: Mothers and Daughters
programme.desc: Korkealla Manhattanin yläpuolella trendikäs ja onnellinen sinkkutyttö Rigby Gray kurkistelee naapureiden asuntoihin ja elämään. Hän piileskelee turvallisesti kameran pitkän linssin takana eikä tiedä, että hänen elämänsä on muuttumassa lopullisesti. Rigbyn otokset muiden elämästä heräävät eloon risteävissä tarinoissa, joissa äiti-lapsisuhteet esiintyvät kaikissa muodoissaan. Huomaamme, että siskot ja tuntemattomat, kämppikset ja rakastajat, jopa painajaismaiset anopit voivat olla mitä rakastettavimpia äitihahmoja.

programme.title: The Dressmaker
programme.desc: The Dressmaker on tarina kauniista ja lahjakkaasta Tilly Dunnagesta. Työskenneltyään vuosia räätälinä Pariisin hienostuneissa muotitaloissa, Tilly palaa pieneen kaupunkiin Australian takamailla yhdistyäkseen jälleen eksentrisen äitinsä Mollyn kanssa. Hän rakastuu hyväsydämiseen Teddyyn, ja ompelukoneensa sekä haute couture -vaatteidensa avulla Tilly muuttaa kaupungin naiset samalla, kun hän kantaa kaunaa niitä kohtaan, jotka ovat kohdelleet häntä kaltoin.

programme.title: The Greatest
programme.desc: Allen ja Grace Brewerin vanhin poika on kuollut auto-onnettomuudessa. Yhtäkkiäovikello soi, ja oven takana on Rose. Hän väittää tunteneensa pojan ja kantavansahänen lastaan. Tieto saa perheen etääntymään toisistaan. Voiko kauheista onnettomuuksista seurata kuitenkin jotain hyvää?

programme.title: New York Immigrant
programme.desc: Maahantulotarkastuksessa ilmenee, että keuhkosairautensa vuoksi Magda joutuu jäämään karanteeniin ja Ewa siirretään yksin Manhattanin kolkkoihin ja pahamaineisiin kortteleihin. Vieraassa kaupungissa ja erossa sisarestaan Ewa tutustuu hurmaavaan ja auttavaiseen Brunoon (Phoenix), jonka vilpittömyys paljastuukin pian julmaksi juoneksi, jolla Ewa pakotetaan mukaan prostituutioon. Unelmiensa tulevaisuuden muututtua hetkessä kuin yönmustaksi painajaiseksi, on Ewan etsittävä keino paeta. Hän tajuaa ainoan tilaisuutensa vihdoin koittaneen tavatessaan Emilin (Renner), Brunon serkun, joka tarjoaa ystävällisesti apuaan.

programme.title: The Bygone
programme.desc: Nuori maankiertäjä liikuskelee maaseudulla etsien elämälleen uutta suuntaa. Läheisen reservaatin lähistöllä hän kohtaa Lakotasta tulleen naisen. Kun nainen äkkiä katoaa, aloitetaan laajat etsinnät. Katoamista selvitettäessä esille nousee riipaiseva menneisyys ja aavistus hyvin haastavasta tulevaisuudesta.

programme.title: The Rum Diary
programme.desc: Hunter S. Thompsonin Rommipäiväkirja-romaaniin pohjautuva elokuva seuraa kiertolaiselämää viettävän reportteri Paul Kempin (Johnny Depp) viinanhuuruista matkaa halki Puerto Ricon pittoreskin saaren. Hän on pian omaksunut paikallisväestön rommiinhukuttautuvan elämäntavan, ja tavattuaan hämäräbisneksiin sekaantuneen amerikkalaisliikemiehen, Sandersonin (Aaron Eckhart), Paul on myös korviaan myöten retkussa miehen huumaavan kuumaan kihlattuun, Chenaultiin (Amber Heard).

programme.title: Danny Collins
programme.desc: Al Pacino esittää ikääntyvää 1970-luvun rokkaria Danny Collinsia, joka ei osaa luopua rankasta elämäntyylistään. Kun hänen managerinsa löytää John Lennonin toimittamatta jääneen kirjeen Collinsille neljänkymmenen vuoden takaa, Collins päättää muuttaa elämänsä ja lähtee riipaisevalle matkalle etsimään perhettään, rakkautta ja uutta mahdollisuutta. Elokuvan upean soundtrackin helminä kuullaan John Lennonin lauluja.

programme.title: American Wrestler: The Wizard
programme.desc: Vuonna 1980 teini-ikäinen poika pakenee Iranin levottomuuksia vain kohdatakseen lisää vihamielisyyksiä Amerikassa panttivankikriisin vuoksi. Päättäväisenä sopeutua hän liittyy koulun horjuvaan painijoukkueeseen.

programme.title: 30:e november
programme.desc: Adam kavereineen käyttää aikaansa vihaamiensa maahanmuuttajien häiriköintiin. Sitten Adam tapaa perulaisen Julian ja he salamarakastuvat. He tapaavat salassa, koska Adamin kaverit tai Julian perhe eivät hyväksyisi suhdetta. Ruotsin kansallispäivänä Adam kavereineen kohtaavat Julian veli Saschan ystävineen. Kohtaaminen johtaa kahden kuolemaan.

programme.title: Free State of Jones
programme.desc: Yhdysvaltain sisällissotaan sijoittuvan draaman pääroolissa nähdään Oscar-voittaja Matthew McConaughey. Newton Knight (McConaughey) palaa Mississippiin ja perustaa muiden sotakarkureiden sekä naisten ja pakoon päässeiden orjien kanssa vallankumousliikkeen. Yhtenä rintamana kapinalliset nousevat paikallista, korruptoitunutta etelävaltioiden hallintoa vastaan.

programme.title: Winter's Bone
programme.desc: 17-vuotias Ree Dolly asuu perheineen ränsistyneessä talossa Ozarkissa, keskellä Yhdysvaltoja. Köyhän ja lainsuojattoman seudun asukkaista valtaosa elää huumekaupalla. Ree hoitaa yksin mielisairasta äitiään ja kahta nuorempaa sisarustaan, kun hän joutuu lähtemään etsimään kadonnutta isäänsä pitääkseen katon perheensä pään päällä. Mutta miten saada vastauksia, kun kukaan ei suostu puhumaan?

programme.title: Gringa
programme.desc: Ongelmia kokenut teinityttö lähtee Meksikoon etsimään isäänsä, jota hän ei edes tunne. He opettelevat yhdessä olemaan perhe, vaikka ensin heitä yhdistävät vain menetykset.

programme.title: The Bygone
programme.desc: Nuori maankiertäjä liikuskelee maaseudulla etsien elämälleen uutta suuntaa. Läheisen reservaatin lähistöllä hän kohtaa Lakotasta tulleen naisen. Kun nainen äkkiä katoaa, aloitetaan laajat etsinnät. Katoamista selvitettäessä esille nousee riipaiseva menneisyys ja aavistus hyvin haastavasta tulevaisuudesta.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: Astrid on 15-vuotias tyttö, jonka elämä muuttuu peruuttamattomalla tavalla, kun poliisi saapuu pidättämään hänen äitiään. Ingrid-äiti päätyy telkien taakse murhattuaan poikaystävänsä ja alaikäinen Astrid aloittaa oman kujanjuoksunsa. Sijaiskoti toisensa jälkeen tulee tutuksi kapinalliselle teini-ikäiselle, joka yrittää epätoivoisesti löytää oman identiteettinsä ihmisten ja maisemien alati vaihtuessa hänen ympärillään. Astridin tavatessa pojan nimeltä Paul herää toivo, että myös ystävyydellä ja rakkaudella voisi olla sijaa hänen elämässään.

programme.title: Danny Collins
programme.desc: Al Pacino esittää ikääntyvää 1970-luvun rokkaria Danny Collinsia, joka ei osaa luopua rankasta elämäntyylistään. Kun hänen managerinsa löytää John Lennonin toimittamatta jääneen kirjeen Collinsille neljänkymmenen vuoden takaa, Collins päättää muuttaa elämänsä ja lähtee riipaisevalle matkalle etsimään perhettään, rakkautta ja uutta mahdollisuutta. Elokuvan upean soundtrackin helminä kuullaan John Lennonin lauluja.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Albert Nobbs kertoo koskettavan tarinan 1800-luvun lopun Irlannissa, missä köyhän naisen elämä on mahdotonta ilman elättäjää. Vuosikaudet Albert Nobbs on selvinnyt pukeutumalla mieheksi voidakseen työskennellä hovimestarina Dublinin yläluokan hotellissa. Tavatessaan hotelliin saapuvan komean maalarin, Albert havaitsee että elämä voi tarjota mahdollisuuksia myös hänen kaltaiselleen.

programme.title: I, Daniel Blake
programme.desc: Todenmakuinen draamaelokuva ruotii koskettavasti hyvinvointiyhteiskunnan horjumista. 59-vuotias Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) on työskennellyt suurimman osan elämästään puuseppänä Newcastlessa. Sydänkohtauksen ja työtapaturman suistettua hänen elämänsä raiteiltaan hän saa huomata, ettei yhteiskunnan turvaverkko kannattelekaan kaikkia. Byrokratiakoneiston rattaisiin juututtuaan Daniel tutustuu samassa tilanteessa olevaan yksinhuoltajaäiti Katieen (Hayley Squires), joka painii omien ongelmiensa kanssa. I, Daniel Blake voitti keväällä Cannesin elokuvajuhlien kilpailusarjan pääpalkinnon eli Kultaisen palmun.

programme.title: Beatrix Potter
programme.desc: Hän on ihastuttanut monia sukupolvia, mutta hänen elämänsä on ollut salaisuus. Tähän saakka. Beatrix Potter on 30-vuotias sinkkunainen aikana, jolloin naisen kunnioitettavin tehtävä on mennä hyviin naimisiin. Kukaan, ei edes Beatrixin oma perhe, ymmärrä sitä, että Beatrix haluaa mieluummin piirtää ja kertoa tarinoita eläimistä. Kaikki menee pieleen, kun Beatrix tapaa kokemattoman kustantajan Norman Waynen, joka rakastuu korviaan myöten niin Beatrixin ainutlaatuisiin tarinoihin kuin itse Beatrixiinkin. Beatrix joutuu mahdottomaan tilanteeseen, jossa hänen pitää irrottautua perheen tukahduttavasta otteesta.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: Kronikka 1700-luvun aristokraatin, Devonshiren herttuattaren Georgianan, elämästä. Häntä kunnioitettiin hänen ylellisestä poliittisesta ja henkilökohtaisesta elämästään.

programme.title: Journey's End
programme.desc: Länsirintama, 18. maaliskuuta 1918. Massiivisen saksalaishyökkäyksen uhatessa komppania siirtyy kuuden päivän taistelurintamalle. Komppaniaa johtaa sodan uupunut, uupunut ja alkoholisti kapteeni Stanhope. Komppaniaan liittyy vastavalmistunut vänrikki Raleigh. Raleigh tunsi Stanhopen koulusta ja pyysi päästä hänen komppaniaansa. Stanhope ei tajua, kuinka paljon tämä on muuttunut.

programme.title: The Shack
programme.desc: Menestysromaaniin perustuva The Shack vie meidät isän kiehtovalle henkiselle matkalle. Perhetragediasta selviytynyt Mack Phillips vajoaa syvään masennukseen ja alkaa epäillä vakaimpia uskomuksiaan. Kesken uskonkriisin hän saa salaperäisen kirjeen, joka johdattaa hänet hylättyyn majaan kaukana erämaassa. Majalla hän tapaa kolme ventovierasta ihmistä, joita johtaa nainen. Tämän kohtaamisen kautta Mack löytää tärkeitä totuuksia, jotka mullistavat hänen käsityksensä kokemastaan tragediasta ja muuttavat hänen elämänsä lopullisesti.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Tositarina irlantilaisesta hävittäjälentäjä Brendan ”Paddy” Finucanesta, josta vain 21-vuotiaana tuli Royal Air Forcen nuorin laivueenkomentaja ja yksi toisen maailmansodan suurimmista ja palkituimmista hävittäjä-ässistä.

programme.title: Time Out of Mind
programme.desc: George on epätoivoinen mies. Hänen terveytensä horjuu ja hänellä ei ole mitään minkä puoleen kääntyä, ja pian hän löytää itsensä New York Cityn anteeksiantamattomilta kaduilta. Käytettyään loppuun kaikki väliaikaisen majoituksen vaihtoehdot hän hakee turvapaikkaa Bellevuen sairaalasta, Mahattanin suurimmasta kodittomien miesten vastaanottokeskuksesta. Sekin osoittautuu raa'aksi ja vaikeakulkuiseksi ympäristöksi täynnä samalla tavalla syrjäytyneitä sieluja. Mutta Georgen ystävystyttyä kokeneeseen yömaja-asukkiin Dixoniin hän alkaa kypsytellä mielessään toivoa siitä, että saisi korjattua suhteen tyttäreensä, josta on vieraantunut.

programme.desc: Today the Central region chefs Aktar Islam, Mark Poynton and Jason Hodnett go head to head cooking their main courses for the veteran judge. With Mark and Aktar fighting for the lead can Jason sneak under the radar to take them by surprise?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the fish course and those chefs who didnt make it onto the shortlist with their starters yesterday are hoping to do better today. Who will be in with a chance of cooking their fish course at the banquet?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the half-way point in finals week and those chefs who have yet to get a dish onto the shortlist are feeling the heat. With nine dishes tasted and the scores in, theres a shock result for the chefs.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: When the Dessert result is in its down to the judges to pick the perfect menu from all four courses shortlists. Which chef will triumph to cook the starter, fish, main and dessert at the D Day banquet?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The banquet is finally here. Its the culmination of months of hard work as the winning four chefs strive to deliver their dishes to an expectant audience of wartime heroes at St Paul's Cathedral, a bastion of British wartime resilience.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three top chefs from Scotland all competition newcomers are out to impress this weeks veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of Scotlands finest chefs are competing to be crowned champion. All week Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today one chef will go home and today the veteran judge finds himself with a very difficult decision to make. Inventive Chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish deserts of his childhood inspired by a local hero honoured by the Queen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. Scotlands two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today it is the starter course of the South West Regional heat. Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Josh is the Michelin star chef proprietor at The Pony and Trap near Bristol.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: There are some exciting dishes on the menu today as the three chefs from the South West a region renowned for its seafood - tackle the fish course.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The South West regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort and today they are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is Head Chef for one of the UKs leading culinary talents Simon Rogan, heading up Simons The French restaurant at Manchesters Midland hotel.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning NW champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. Last year his fish course was shortlisted for the banquet in the national finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the North West Regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges and he is feeling the strain.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting highly creative producing some of the most original and stunning desserts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Its the dessert course that seals the fate of the chefs and the North West Champion is revealed.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael and Adam Bannister. Adam was crowed Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident, he is passionate about seafood. Adam Bannister has created a modern take on the old boil in the bag fish dinners and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Returning Chef, Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an O.B.E, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week in the Welsh heat newcomer Andrew Birch is challenging two returning chefs, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael. It is the dessert course and one chef will go home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers are competing to become regional Central champion - Daniel Smith, Andrew Scott and Danny Gill. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Cliffords two star restaurant Midsummer House.

programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UKs best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Daniel Smith may be classically trained but hes decided to take a risk adding a cheese custard to his lobster dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up Wellington for royalty. While Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queens Scottish estate, Balmoral.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. Today one competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. And the chefs are pushing themselves.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The Central regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.desc: Its the all important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Hes showcasing British Rose veal and celebrating the determination of British producers to bounce back from disaster.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the North East Regional title but hes competing against two young newcomers Tommy Banks and Chris Archer.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the main course of the North East Region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. Its a tough and emotional day for the chefs.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own Great Briton, his late Grandfather.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for an historic score, he could beat his boss a veteran of GBM and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the National Finals of Great British Menu and main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. It is a nerve wracking day for three of the eight regional champions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the final day of the competition in this years Great British Menu, this is the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth lls Great Britons.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Tiraditos! No, it's not a joyous exclamation (even though it sounds a little like one...) it's a Peruvian dish that lands somewhere between traditional Peruvian ceviche and Japanese sashimi. Chef Craig Wong's version is made with swordfish and includes sweet potatoes pureed with spicy Aji Amarillo chilies. For his Lebanese tribute, check out Lamb Neck cured and slow-poached in olive oil for a melt-in- your-mouth result, paired with an intense, flavourful Black Baba Ghanoush made with charred eggplant and caramelized onions. For a common ingredient, it is two takes on potato: Lomo Saltado with grilled flank steak, and a cheese, herb, olive oil and lemon drenched Hasselback Batata Harra....

programme.title: One World Kitchen

programme.desc: Spices are extremely important to Lebanese cuisine and host Jasmin Ibrahim uses a ton of them in four tasty Lebanese dishes. Moving on, Jasmin then makes a thick and spicy beef stew. It's eaten vermicelli rice and seasoned with a classic Lebanese 7-spice combo. Next up, Theresa balances tart grapefruit with a sweet buttery lobster tail. But that's not sweet enough for Theresa! She prepares sabayon, a delicate honey custard that melts in your mouth. Finally, Theresa shows us how to make a mouth-watering dish by combining...

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Chicken and corn are the key players in this letter “C” challenge. Chef Lauren Gulyas prepares one of her favourite Italian dishes, chicken Marsala. Using garlic, shallots, and white wine, Chef Lauren whips up a rich Marsala sauce that is nutty and floral in flavour. Next, she transforms corn into a creamy polenta topping for her Shepard’s pie...with a twist! Sautéing onion, garlic, and lean ground beef, she uses Worcestershire sauce and tomato paste to give the pie filling an extra flavour boost. Once she finishes those dishes, Chef Lauren creates a mouth-watering recipe that combines both chicken and corn.

programme.desc: Chef Robert Jewell has a challenge on his hands after picking the letter “K.” He decides to use ingredients kaffir lime and kohlrabi. First, Robert re-invents the ordinary shrimp skewer, using lemongrass as the skewer (yes, the skewer!). He brings the flavour to the next level with zesty kaffir lime. Using the leaves of the kaffir lime with fresh herbs, Robert makes a dipping sauce for the skewer. Next, Robert fries up salty peameal bacon in one pan and sautés earthy kohlrabi with leeks, potato, and garlic in another. He brings the ingredients together into a single skillet, adding eggs and baking it into a hearty frittata. For his final dish, Robert uses both kaffir lime and kohlrabi in...

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: “A” is on the menu and Chef Robert Jewell takes on this meal challenge with apricots and avocados. First up, Robert cooks a spicy roasted quail and drizzles it with some sweet apricot and calvados sauce. Next, is a meal best served cold! programme.desc: Unenvartija on sietämättömän jännittävä rikostarina, jossa psykologiset pohjasävyt kuljettavat tapahtumia eteenpäin, kunnes kaikki päättyy dramaattiseen kilpajuoksuun häikäilemättömän murhaajan kanssa. Kuka on tirkistelijä, joka seisoo ikkunassa ja tarkkailee vastapäisen asunnon nuoria naisia? Liittyykö hän jotenkin 19-vuotiaan Therese Geberin murhaan, ja onko hän sama kuin mies, joka tunkeutuu yöllä naisten asuntoon? Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa uuden jutun ratkaistavakseen.

programme.title: Imaginary Heroes
programme.desc: Nokkela, herkullisen ivallinen tarina perheestä, jonka kulissit alkavat sortua vakavan tragedian seurauksena. Perheen nuorin poika hautoo kipeää salaisuutta kuin pahan unen vankina. Äiti laukoo sarkastisia ajatuksia ja hukuttaa tuskansa pulloon ja naapurin yksinhuoltajaan. Katkeransuolaista huumoria, lämpöä, rakkautta ja kaikkea siltä väliltä.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Autumn in New York
programme.desc: Will Keane on viittäkymppiä lähestyvä menestyvä newyorkilainen ravintoloitsija ja parantumaton naistenmies. Mies purjehtii suhteesta toiseen - kunnes hän kohtaa nuoren Charlotten. Vielä kokematon Charlotte on sulaa vahaa maailmanmiehen käsittelyssä, mutta romanssi saa tylyn lopun. Will tajuaa menettäneensä kenties viimeisen tilaisuuden todelliseen rakkauteen. Voiko vanha tiikeri päästä eroon raidoistaan? Will päättää yrittää...

programme.title: Alright Now
programme.desc: Rock-muusikko ilmoittautuu yliopistoon erottuaan poikaystävästään ja hänen bändinsä hajoaa.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: Rakkaus voittaa kaiken. Jopa vastustamattoman pakon syödä kumppaninsa aivokudosta! Lähitulevaisuudessa maapallolla asuu yhtä paljon ihmisiä syöviä zombeja kuin myös zombeja vastaan taistelevia ihmisiä. Hetken mielijohteesta nuori zombi R pelastaa toisten zombien hyökkäykseltä Julien, jonka suonissa veri virtaa kovaa. Heidän ystävyytensä uhkaa sen hetkistä maailmanjärjestystä! Julien pitää vain pysyä hengissä ja R:n pitää pysyä kuolleena tarpeeksi kauan.

programme.title: Elegy
programme.desc: David Kepesh on arvostettu yliopiston professori, jonka maailma järkkyy, kun hänen luennoilleen ilmestyy kaunis Consuela Castillo. Consuelan kauneus ajaa professorin himon ja omistushalun pyörteeseen, jollaista hän ei ole aiemmin kokenut. Mutkikas rakkaustarina saa alkunsa. Perustuu Pulitzer-palkitun Philip Rothin teokseen.

programme.title: Welcome to Collinwood
programme.desc: Tuomiotaan lusiva taparikollinen Cosimo saa vihiä kaikkien aikojen keikasta. Miehen tyttöystävä Rosalind alkaa valmistella keikkaa kalterien ulkopuolella ja pian osingolle on tunkemassa vähintäänkin värikäs sakki ”ammattimiehiä”. Oman palansa saaliista haluavat niin turhautunut taiteilija kuin italialainen gigolokin, mutta alan miehiä näistä tuurikonnista ei saa tekemälläkään. Onneksi kokenut kassakaappimies Jerzy antaa tunareille pari neuvoa ja täydellinen rikos on lähempänä kuin koskaan!

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Ben Aronoffin tositarina. Hän on maailman nopeimpien veneiden luoja ja suihkuseurapiireissä viihtyvä mies, jolla on säteilevä hymy ja rahaa kuin roskaa. Menestyksellä on silti hintansa. Kun Aronoff on velkaa mafialle ja toimittaa nopeita veneitä huumeiden salakuljettamiseen, huumevirasto painostaa häntä sotaan huumeita vastaan, jolloin hän joutuu vaarantamaan koko elämänsä.

programme.title: What if
programme.desc: Wallacella ei pyyhi erityisen hyvin tyttöjen keskuudessa: kuivalla huumorintajulla varustettu, opintonsa kesken jättänyt nuorukainen on saanut pettyä kerran toisensa jälkeen. Kun jopa kämppäkaveri Allan löytää täydellisen tyttöystävän, turhautunut Wallace päättää lyödä hanskat tiskiin ja pistää rakkauselämänsä jäähylle. Silloin hän törmää Chantryyn, animaattoriin joka asuu yhdessä pitkäaikaisen poikaystävänsä kanssa. Varatusta tytöstä tulee nopeasti Wallacen läheisin ystävä, jonka kanssa voi puhua mistä vain aina lempielokuvista epäonnistuneisiin joululahjoihin. Viestiliikenteen kiivastuessa ja kemian tiivistyessä molemmat joutuvat pohtimaan, voiko paras ystävä ollakin elämän suuri rakkaus.

programme.title: Don't Come Knocking
programme.desc: Hollywood-tähti Howard Spence (Sam Shepard) on nähnyt parempiakin päiviä, mutta nyt hän ratsastaa vain menneellä maineellaan. Jälleen yhden irstailuillan jälkeen hän pakenee uuden länkkärin kuvauksista ja ratsastaa preerialle kuin yksi sankareista, joita hän on niin usein näytellyt. Hän etsii suojaa äitinsä (Eva Marie Saint) luota, jota hän ei ole nähnyt vuosiin. Tosin sielläkään hän ei viivy kauan saatuaan tietää, että hänellä saattaa olla poika, josta hän ei ole tiennyt. Howardille tämä tuo toivoa siitä, ettei hänen elämänsä ole ollutkaan täysin turhaa. Ehkä jossain on paikka, jonne hän kuuluu.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Vuosi on 1985. Pastellivärien, puutelihiusten ja otsanauhojen aikakautena nuori Janey uneksii tanssijan urasta. Koulua hän on ehtinyt vaihtaa jo 11 kertaa, ja hän tietää että ne eivät muutu miksikään. Hänen uusimmassa koulussaan on tosin jotain erikoista. Ei se että se sijaitsee Chicagossa, vaan se että siellä tehdään suosittua nuoriso-ohjelmaa nimeltä Dance TV. Täällä Janey tapaa tanssifriikki Lynnen joka houkuttelee hänet koetanssiin, ja menestyksen ovet alkavat avautua.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: Mary Shelley on kertomus Mary Wollstonecraft Godwinista – maailmankuulun goottilaisen romaanin "Frankensteinin" kirjoittajasta – ja hänen raivokkaasta ja myrskyisästä suhteestaan tunnettuun romanttiseen runoilijaan Percy Bysshe Shelleyyn. Mary ja Percy julistavat rakastavansa toisiaan, ja Maryn perheen kauhuksi pari päättää karata yhdessä. Maryn siskopuoli Claire lähtee Maryn mukaan. Pariskunnan välien kiristyessä lordi Byronin luona Genevenjärvellä syntyy ajatus Frankensteinista, kun seurue päättää kilpailla keskenään parhaan kauhutarinan kirjoittamisessa.

programme.title: Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Vuoristokaupungin ulkopuolella, jota kamppailee sarjan sieppauksia ja murhia, erakkomainen kirjailija Paul (Antonio Banderas) kamppailee aloittaakseen käsikirjoituksen, jonka hän toivoo pelastavan uransa. Kohdattuaan jännittyneen tunnelman kuppilassa Jackin (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) kanssa Paul tarjoaa Jackille yösijaa – ja pian särmikäs ja vaativa Jack murtautuu rajusti Paulin töihin, ja miehet aloittavat rosoisen päihittämispelin, joka päättää ainakin yhden tarinan.

programme.title: Flight World War II
programme.desc: Nykyaikaisen 757:n matkustajat tekevät aikamatkan takaisin 1940-luvulle ja joutuvat kamppailemaan hengestään keskellä saksalaisten ja liittoutuneitten taistelua. Yrittäessään pysyä hengissä he onnistuvat vaikuttamaan historiaan ja toisen maailmansodan loppuratkaisuun.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: Sisäpiirin tarina olutmoguli Alfred "Freddy" Heinekenin sieppaajien suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta, rajuista jälkimainingeista ja lopullisesta tuhosta vuonna 1983, mikä johti suurimpiin koskaan maksettuihin lunnaisiin yksilöstä.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Majava
programme.desc: Majavasta voi olla apua sinullekin! Walter Blackin huumori on yhtä mustaa kuin hänen sukunimensä. Töissä menee huonosti, vaimo on saanut tarpeekseen ja poika vihaa isäänsä. Masennuksen syövereissä - ja kesken itsetuhoisen ryyppyputken - Walter löytää roskasäiliöstä nuhruisen käsinuken. Majavan. Kangasnukke kädessään Walter voi jälleen puhua vapaasti. Ja vieläpä brittiaksentilla! Mutta samalla kun Walter löytää itsensä uudelleen, uusi majavapersoona saa hänestä yliotteen! Kaksinkertaiset Oscar-voittajat Mel Gibson ja Jodie Foster ovat tehneet palkitun käsikirjoituksen avulla yhden vuoden omaperäisimmistä elokuvahelmistä.

Guy, tuo vastentahtoinen kuski ja turvamies, päätyy rokkaavien naisten ja ressukoitten miesten maailmaan. Hurjan ja villin yön aikana, monen läheltä piti -tilanteen jälkeen,

Taika Waititin (Jojo Rabbit, Thor: Ragnarök) debyyttielokuva Eagle vs Shark on ainutlaatuinen komedia, jonka pääosissa ovat Jemaine Clement (Flight of The Conchords, What We Do in the Shadows) ja Loren Horsley.

Täällä asuvat Martha ja Sheryl, jotka perustavat Yhdysvaltojen ensimmäisen huutosakin yli 60-vuotiaille naisille. TÄHTITYTÖT perustuu tositarinaan.

Hän inhoaa paikkaa heti. Elin 41-vuotias kämppis Leo (Brendan Fraser) on entinen suupelaaja, jonka elämä on romahtanut ja joka on päättänyt palata koulun penkille. Omituisesta kaksikosta tulee ystäviä vastoin odotuksia. Eli haluaa kostaa hylkäyksen ja johtaa Whitmanin Collegiate Mastermind -joukkueen mestaruusvoittoon Harvardia vastaan. Samaan aikaan isästään vieraantunut Leon tytär Sophie saapuu tutustumaan kampukseen ja heittää Leon opiskelijaelämän raiteiltaan.

programme.title: The Wedding Guest
programme.desc: Adam (Justin Long) on ​​edelleen rakastunut exään (Cobie Smulders). Joten kun hän ilmestyy hänen häihinsä osoittaakseen, että hän on siirtynyt eteenpäin, sarja hauskoja tapaamisia vain vahvistaa, että hän ei ole koskaan ollut rakastuneempi.

Rafe ei ole mikään vallankumouksellinen anarkisti, mutta hän on kuitenkin aloittamassa koulunkäyntiä jo järjestyksessä kolmannella yläasteellaan. Rafen töitä paiskiva yksinhuoltajaäiti toivoo, että tämä koulu lopultakin sopisi hänen pojalleen. Mutta Hills Villagen yläasteella yksilönvapautta ei kunnioiteta, vaan voimassa ovat epäoikeudenmukaiset käyttäytymissäännöt. Rehtori-Dwight ei jätä huomioimatta yhtäkään rikkomusta, koska hän haluaa pysyä ykkösenä alueen koulujen suoritustilastoissa.

Patologisen valehtelijan munaukset vievät miehen suoraan kaapista häkkiin, kun hän jää luksuselämänsä rahoittamiseen kehitetyistä superhuijauksista kiinni rysän päältä. Vankilassa Stevenin yllättää kuitenkin takaapäin rynnivä rakkaus, jota huijarin taipumukset ja poliisien pamput kuitenkin vaikeuttavat. Stevenillä on kuitenkin sairaita suunnitelmia rakastuneen parin saattamiseksi jälleen yhteen...

Adam ei uskalla heittäytyä uuteen rakkauteen, Mike yrittää raivokkaasti kontrolloida perhettään eikä Danny suostu myöntämään ongelmiaan, mutta haasteet ja pienet askeleet yhdistää miehet perheeksi, joka kannustaa, raivostuttaa ja kiittää toisiaan matkalla uuteen elämään.

programme.title: The Rules of Attraction

programme.title: Nurse Betty

Törmättyään kahteen ammattitappajaan katsoessaan yhtä sarjan jaksoa Betty muuttuu “Nurse Bettyksi" ja lähtee etsimään sydämensä valittua, tohtori David Ravellia. Betty hakee unelmiensa prinssiä hurjalla retkellä halki maan, mutta ehtiikö hän löytää miehen ennen kuin tappajat löytävät hänet?

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian

Kumpikaan ei ole entisessä vedossaan, mutta erikoisten ystäviensä ja rohkaisevan, vaikkakin kyynisen isänsä avulla nämä nahjusmaiset sankarit saattavat oppia voittamaan parhaimmatkin vastustajansa. Rooleissa muun muassa koomikot Jeremy Sisto, Adam Devine ja Oscar®-palkittu J.K. Simmons.

Hauskaja salamyhkäinen ystävyys vesipuiston seurallisen johtajan ja muiden epämääräisten työntekijöidenkanssa auttaa nuoren miehen lopulta altaan pohjalta takaisin aurinkoon.

Mitä tahansa tarkoittaa tässä tapauksessa veljeilyä gangstereitten, stripparijoukon, bestiksen himokkaan äidin, huumehöyryisen pomon, pikkupervon rehtorin, salamyhkäisen pastorin, itsetuhoisen äidin ja mystisiä neuvoja jakavan tukijan kanssa. Kuka sanoikaan rakkauden olevan helppoa...

Ihmiset reagoivat 21 päivän päästä koittavaan maailmanloppuun varsin kirjavilla teoilla. Vakuutusmyyjä Dodgen ja naapurintyttö Pennyn tiet kohtaavat mellakoiden yltyessä ja he päättävät auttaa toisiaan matkalla kohti viimeisiä päämääriään.

programme.title: Herakles New Yorkissa

programme.title: Tähtitytöt
